## Problem and behavior

Describe the concrete trigger and resulting behavior, affected contracts and compatibility.

## Evidence

- [ ] Affected tests and full suite passed; skips and prerequisites are identified.
- [ ] Both declared type checks and `npm run verify` passed.
- [ ] Security/release changes include secret, dependency/license and package evidence.
- [ ] Authority/privacy changes cite an ADR and independent review.
- [ ] Runtime/provider evidence clearly identifies fixtures versus live qualification.
- [ ] No credentials, personal data, local operator paths or private session/incident artifacts are included.
- [ ] No publication, production activation or provider deletion claim is implied.
